_comment2: Use as a reference when creating the service in the Northflank dashboard.
_comment3: All secrets below are set via: Service > Settings > Environment Variables (NOT in this file).

service.name: motto-director
service.description: Autonomous perceive->ideate->act orchestrator. Perceives ONA Fleet state, ideates tasks for each active goal, and spawns Factory droids to execute them.

billing._comment: nf-compute-50 = 0.5 vCPU / 512MB RAM. Sufficient for async Python + HTTP calls.

deployment._comment: Singleton orchestrator — do NOT scale horizontally. The cycle lock in main.py protects against double-spawning but a single replica is cleaner.

image._comment: GitHub Actions builds :latest and :sha-<hash> on every push to main.

service._ports_comment: motto-director is a background worker — no HTTP port is exposed. Health is monitored via ONA Fleet heartbeats (heartbeat every cycle).
service._health_comment: No HTTP health check. Monitor via: ONA Fleet dashboard -> motto-director last_seen_at, or Northflank logs filtered by director.cycle.done.

internalNetworking._comment: Director calls ONA Fleet MCP over HTTPS (external URL). No internal Northflank DNS required.

northflankEnvVars._comment: Set these in Northflank: Service > Settings > Environment Variables
northflankEnvVars._comment2: Mark credential values as Secret (encrypted at rest).

MOTTO_MCP_AUTH_TOKEN._comment: Bearer token for ONA Fleet MCP server. Must match the token set in motto-mcp-server.

FACTORY_API_KEY._comment: Factory.ai API key for spawning droids.

ANTHROPIC_API_KEY._comment: Anthropic API key. Used by spawned droids via the Factory platform.

DIRECTOR_DRY_RUN._comment: Set to 1 to log proposed spawns without actually calling Factory API. Safe for rollout testing.

githubActionsSecrets._comment: Set these in GitHub repo Settings > Secrets and variables > Actions for CI/CD

dopplerConfig._comment2: Pull command: doppler run --project motto-core --config prd -- python main.py
